description: Generate or refresh the buying committee DealMap for a prospect. DealMaps are family-grain: a subsidiary ticker resolves upward to the corporate family (a generate that resolves to your team's saved family map is not charged) and the response names the family. Maps the org structure and assigns stakeholder roles (Economic Buyer, Decision Maker, Champion, etc.) using AI analysis. Billing: 10 credits for any new generation or force_refresh; only a reuse of your team's saved map (annotated_cache_hit) is free. Failed generations are not charged. Your team's saved map is reused when available. The response contains the full DealMap (no follow-up get_dealmap needed). Each generation takes ~15-45s, so for several companies run up to 10 generate_dealmap calls in parallel rather than one at a time; limited to 20 generation requests per minute per API key — on a 429, wait Retry-After seconds and retry only the rejected calls. After a timeout, check get_dealmap before retrying; completion is not guaranteed. Avoid force_refresh unless the user explicitly requests it, or freshness on a reused map shows newer people data and the user agrees to the refresh cost (freshness.refresh_credits). Requires "outreach" scope on the API key. Errors: 422 company_identity_unresolved means DealSurface couldn't identify the company, and 422 dealmap_data_unavailable means no org information is available for it; tell the user and don't retry. 409 dealmap_generation_in_progress means a generation for this corporate family is already running (common when two tickers in a batch share a family): wait, then call get_dealmap instead of generating again. A full DealMap can be very large; start from buying_committee_summary.

force_refresh.description: Force fresh org chart fetch. Use sparingly — consumes credits.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (subsidiary tickers resolve to the corporate family)

name: generate_dealmap
